objective: Retained capture changed a passing result to a fail. This is a draft signal, not an accepted finding or an authorization decision.
checkDescription: Continuous monitoring compared this result with the previous retained capture.
risk: A previously passing control or KSI failed on the next retained capture. Agency risk acceptance is not recorded.
action: Draft plan of action prepared from the regression. A person must review it before it is accepted.
milestone: Review the regression and record a decision.
history: Draft plan of action prepared from a continuous-monitoring regression. Not accepted.
baseline: Continuous monitoring comparison of retained captures. Not an authorization determination.
limitations: Read-only comparison of retained captures. Customer systems are not modified.
A regression draft is not accepted, closed, or an authorization decision.
Synthetic and unapproved captures are not agency evidence.
gateBlocking: Passing result changed to fail and is not allowlisted.
emptyTimeline: No retained results for this control.
collectorTrigger: Collector does not accept this trigger.
futureCapture: Capture time is in the future.
staleCapture: Capture time is older than the retained timeline for this source.
commitMismatch: Capture commit does not match the trigger.
remoteFetchRefused: Repo scanner reads a capture supplied by the caller. It does not fetch remote systems.
